name: mirage
text: Not tax advice. Under-reporting income is the risk: if the IRS finds it (platforms can send them a 1099 or the amounts show up in bank deposits), you'd owe the missing tax plus interest and usually a 20% accuracy penalty, and knowingly hiding income can be treated as fraud. Missing records is not a reason to leave it out, because there are ways to rebuild them: Novig's own account history/ledger, the app's Tracker (every bet is saved to GitHub), and your bank/deposit records. Those cover most of it. If something is still missing, report your best honest estimate and keep a note of how you got it; a good-faith estimate is far safer than a zero. A tax preparer can help with that. I can export a clean winnings/losses summary by month from the app's saved bets if you want it, just say so.
